thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (compute-gpu-node-monitor) — alert: NODE_SILENT — host: gpu-node-42.us-west-2a — heartbeat missing >90s — link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/P12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert P12345 created, incident #INC-2026-874. Severity: high. Escalation policy: SRE-oncall.

sam: acked and taking. digging in.

maya: thx sam — any customer impact reported?

sam: checking metrics now. grafana shows kubelet last_seen ~01:17:30 UTC, node removed from cluster autoscaler pool. some high-priority training pods moved, but 2 stateful pods pinned to gpu-node-42 are Pending. no direct 5xx spikes yet, but a couple of batch jobs failed to start.

sam: ran quick check:
```
$ kubectl get nodes gpu-node-42 -o wide
NAME            STATUS     ROLES   AGE   VERSION
gpu-node-42     NotReady   gpu     32d   v1.26.3
```

sam: and pods on node:
```
$ kubectl get pods -o wide --all-namespaces | grep gpu-node-42
ml-train-7      Pending   0/1    1h   N/A   gpu-node-42
stateful-db-1   Pending   0/1    4h   N/A   gpu-node-42
```

dave: can you try serial console / BMC SSH? might be hung at kernel driver level. if unresponsive, we should cordon+drain and force reboot via BMC.

sam: SSH to node direct is timing out. Serial attach in progress (ipmi-console).

juan: tagging infra-ops for possible power-cycle. also posting a quick mitigation: cordon first to prevent new pods:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-42
kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sam: ran cordon. drain started but stuck — kubelet API not responding so eviction timed out.

maya: customer impact update: two customers (team-a, internal-benchmarking) saw job startup failures. team-a's training job retried and completed on other nodes after 7m. internal-benchmarking had 2 failed runs. no public API outages. logging ticket to notify them.

sam: serial output shows kernel log tail (attaching snippet):
```
[  90.123456] nvidia: GPU watchdog triggered, reset attempt failed
[  90.123789] usb 3-1: hub_reset: port 1 power cycle failed
[  91.000001] watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 23s
```

sam: not exactly a kernel panic but hardware/driver hang. BMC reachable. requesting power-cycle.

carol: noted. confirm BMC action and RMA flow if reboot doesn't clear. please record serial logs for postmortem.

sam: BMC session: remote power-cycle issued (IPMI -> chassis power cycle). Rebooting.

incident-bot: Reboot command acknowledged by BMC. Will monitor node heartbeat for 5 minutes.

dave: while rebooting, let's evacuate any remaining workloads tied to pvc on that host — open support ticket to unstick PV attachments if they persist.

sam: node back online at 01:22:18 UTC — kubelet registered. health checks passing. pods starting to move back.

sam: kubelet logs show driver reinitialization succeeded, hint of thermal throttling but stable now.

juan: re-running drain/evict to reschedule the two pending pods to other nodes (safe mode).

sam: migration complete for the two stateful pods. team-a confirmed their job resumed on new node. internal-benchmarking reran and passed.

maya: thanks — please escalate to postmortem if we hit a pattern. add notes: host gpu-node-42, suspected GPU driver hang -> BMC power-cycle fixed. customer impact: 2 failed runs, brief scheduler delays.

carol: assigning follow-up: open a PBI to track fleet-wide health checks for GPU driver hangs, add automatic BMC reboot runbook, and consider node replacement if repeat within 30d.

sam: handing off to night on-call — @juan, please own the follow-up and monitor the node for 24h. actions: collect full dmesg, attach serial logs to INC-2026-874, coordinate RMA if recurrence.

juan: taking handoff. thanks. tagging incident resolved for active paging — will keep incident open for follow-up docs. :white_check_mark:
summary: PagerDuty alert for gpu-node-42 (NODE_SILENT). kubelet NotReady, serial logs showed GPU watchdog/soft lockup. BMC power-cycle restored node. Two jobs retried; limited customer impact. Handed off to night on-call for follow-up.
